mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.2% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.2% in a month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer spending and economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production below 103.0, manufacturing sector contraction signals reduced economic output and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is below 103.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers hawkish monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the prior three months indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the prior three months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both real GDP (GDPC1) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based slowdown in consumer and housing demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 103.5 indicates robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is above 103.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
